summary: John's 11th-great-grandfather; Norfolk emigrant of 1637 who went from Hingham, Massachusetts, to Southold.
bio: Baptized 'Henrye Tutthill' 28 Jun 1612 at St Mary, Tharston, aged 5 when his father died in 1618. Sailed 1637 in the Mary Anne of Yarmouth (William Goose, master) as 'Henry Tuthill and wife, of Saxlingham, Norfolk' (Banks, Planters of the Commonwealth p. 183). Hingham, Mass.: planting lot 1635 (per Round 2/Akerly) and house lot 1637; freeman 1638; constable 1640; sold out 20 Jun 1644 and went to Southold. Died before 15 Dec 1650 (tree says 1644). His widow Bridget married William Wells. Akerly's suggestion that William Tuttle of New Haven (Planter, 1635) was Henry's brother William (bapt. Tharston 1609) is disproven: William of New Haven's son Thomas was baptized 4 Jan 1634 at Ringstead, Northamptonshire (FreeREG; Green, TAG 56:143; WikiTree Tuttle-29).
